arxiv-2006-01418.title: Time-Dilation Attacks on the Lightning Network
arxiv-2006-01418.creator: Antoine Riard, Gleb Naumenko
arxiv-2006-01418.description: Abstract . Lightning Network (LN) is a widely-used network of payment channels enabling faster and cheaper Bitcoin transactions. In this paper, we outline three ways an attacker can steal funds from honest LN users. The attacks require dilating the time for victims to become aware of new blocks by eclipsing (isolating) victims from the network and delaying block delivery.

arxiv-2012-09167.title: Probing Particle Physics with Gravitational Waves
arxiv-2012-09167.creator: Horng Sheng Chia
arxiv-2012-09167.description: Abstract \thesisfont cmr \thesissectionstyle \thesissectionsizes See Cover.pdf \basedon Publications This thesis is based on the following publications: [ 46 ] D. A.

arxiv-2106-16086.title: A Comprehensive Survey on STP Approach to Finite Games
arxiv-2106-16086.creator: Daizhan Cheng, Yuhu Wu, Guodong Zhao, Shihua Fu
arxiv-2106-16086.description: Abstract Nowadays the semi-tensor product (STP) approach to finite games has become a promising new direction. This paper provides a comprehensive survey on this prosperous field. After a brief introduction for STP and finite (networked) games, a description for the principle and fundamental technique of STP approach to finite games is presented.

arxiv-2109-08433.title: The Veneziano Amplitude via Mostly BRST Exact Operator
arxiv-2109-08433.creator: Isao Kishimoto, Tomoko Sasaki, Shigenori Seki and, Tomohiko Takahashi
arxiv-2109-08433.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Isao Kishimoto, Tomoko Sasaki, Shigenori Seki and, Tomohiko Takahashi. The Veneziano amplitude is derived from fixing one degree of freedom of P ​ S ​ L ​ ( 2 , ℝ ) PSL(2,\mathbb{R}) symmetry by the insertion of a mostly BRST exact operator. Evaluating the five-point function which consists of four open string tachyons and this gauge fixing operator, we find it equals the Veneziano amplitude up to a sign factor. The sign factor is interpreted as a signed intersection number.

arxiv-2204-11507.title: Rescuing constraints on modified gravity using gravitational redshift in large-scale structure
arxiv-2204-11507.creator: Sveva Castello, Nastassia Grimm, Camille Bonvin
arxiv-2204-11507.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sveva Castello, Nastassia Grimm, Camille Bonvin. The distribution of galaxies provides an ideal laboratory to test for deviations from General Relativity. In particular, redshift-space distortions are commonly used to constrain modifications to the Poisson equation, which governs the strength of dark matter clustering. Here, we show that these constraints rely on the validity of the weak equivalence principle, which has never been tested for the dark matter component.

arxiv-2208-01861.title: Quarkophobic W’ for LHC searches
arxiv-2208-01861.creator: A. Gurrola 1 , J. D. Ruiz-Álvarez 2
arxiv-2208-01861.description: Abstract We consider a simplified model where a W’ boson is added to the standard model with negligible couplings to quarks, but generic couplings to leptons and electroweak bosons. We study the implications of such a model for LHC searches.

arxiv-2309-11824.title: Word Embedding with Neural Probabilistic Prior
arxiv-2309-11824.creator: Shaogang Ren, Dingcheng Li, Ping Li
arxiv-2309-11824.description: Abstract To improve word representation learning, we propose a probabilistic prior which can be seamlessly integrated with word embedding models. Different from previous methods, word embedding is taken as a probabilistic generative model, and it enables us to impose a prior regularizing word representation learning.

arxiv-2405-17559.title: New horizon symmetries, hydrodynamics, and quantum chaos
arxiv-2405-17559.creator: Maria Knysh, Hong Liu, Natalia Pinzani-Fokeeva
arxiv-2405-17559.description: Abstract We generalize the formulation of horizon symmetries presented in previous literature to include diffeomorphisms that can shift the location of the horizon. In the context of the AdS/CFT duality, we show that horizon symmetries can be interpreted on the boundary as emergent low-energy gauge symmetries.

arxiv-2407-18840.title: The Cross-environment Hyperparameter Setting Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2407-18840.creator: Andrew Patterson, Samuel Neumann, Raksha Kumaraswamy, Martha White, Adam White
arxiv-2407-18840.description: Abstract This paper introduces a new empirical methodology, the Cross-environment Hyperparameter Setting Benchmark, that compares RL algorithms across environments using a single hyperparameter setting, encouraging algorithmic development which is insensitive to hyperparameters. We demonstrate that this benchmark is robust to statistical noise and obtains qualitatively similar results across repeated applications, even when using few samples.

arxiv-2408-09184.title: Der Weg zur digitalen Arbeitsmappe Digitales Prüfungswesen mit Zertifizierung 10.07.2024
arxiv-2408-09184.creator: Martin Becke 1 † , Julia Padberg 1 *
arxiv-2408-09184.description: Abstract Ziel der Arbeit ist es, einen alternativen Ansatz zur Erfassung und Bewertung von Studierendenleistung vorzustellen, der eine nachhaltige Leistungserfassung mit der Möglichkeit der Integration von insbesondere Praxisanteilen ermöglicht. Das angestrebte Ergebnis ist eine digitale Mappe mit Arbeitsproben – und nicht nur Zeugnissen, die im Rahmen der akademischen Bewertung als Portfolioprüfung verstanden werden kann.

arxiv-2409-16277.title: Compressed Depth Map Super-Resolution and Restoration: AIM 2024 Challenge Results
arxiv-2409-16277.creator: Marcos V. Conde †‡, Florin-Alexandru Vasluianu †, Jinhui Xiong †, Wei Ye †, Rakesh Ranjan †, Radu Timofte †, Huan Zheng, Wencheng Han, Tianyi Yan, Jianbing Shen, Pihai Sun, Yuanqi Yao, Kui Jiang, Wenbo Zhao, Xianming Liu, Evgeny Burnaev, Junjun Jiang, Woojae Han, Kyeonghyun Lee, Seongmin Hong, Se Yo
arxiv-2409-16277.description: Abstract The increasing demand for augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) applications highlights the need for efficient depth information processing. Depth maps, essential for rendering realistic scenes and supporting advanced functionalities, are typically large and challenging to stream efficiently due to their size.

arxiv-2410-08030.title: Chaos in opinion-driven disease dynamics
arxiv-2410-08030.creator: Thomas Götz, Tyll Krüger, Karol Niedzielewski, Radomir Pestow, Moritz Schäfer, Jan Schneider
arxiv-2410-08030.description: Abstract During the COVID-19 pandemic, it became evident that the effectiveness of applying intervention measures is significantly influenced by societal acceptance, which, in turn, is affected by the processes of opinion formation. This article explores one among the many possibilities of a coupled opinion-epidemic system.

arxiv-2411-10188.title: Reachability Analysis of the Domain Name System
arxiv-2411-10188.creator: Dhruv Nevatia, Si Liu, David Basin
arxiv-2411-10188.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dhruv Nevatia, Si Liu, David Basin. The high complexity of DNS poses unique challenges for ensuring its security and reliability. Despite continuous advances in DNS testing, monitoring, and verification, protocol-level defects still give rise to numerous bugs and attacks. In this paper, we provide the first decision procedure for the DNS verification problem, establishing its complexity as 𝟤 ​ 𝖤 ​ 𝗑 ​ 𝗉 ​ 𝖳 ​ 𝗂 ​ 𝗆 ​ 𝖾 \mathsf{2ExpTime} , which was previously unknown.

arxiv-2507-08088.title: Real-Time Dynamics in a (2+1)-D Gauge Theory: The Stringy Nature on a Superconducting Quantum Simulator
arxiv-2507-08088.creator: Jesús Cobos, Joana Fraxanet, César Benito, Francesco di Marcantonio, Pedro Rivero, Kornél Kapás, Miklós Antal Werner, Örs Legeza, Alejandro Bermudez, Enrique Rico
arxiv-2507-08088.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jesús Cobos, Joana Fraxanet, César Benito, Francesco di Marcantonio, Pedro Rivero, Kornél Kapás, Miklós Antal Werner, Örs Legeza, Alejandro Bermudez, Enrique Rico. Understanding the confinement mechanism in gauge theories and the universality of effective string-like descriptions of gauge flux tubes remains a fundamental challenge in modern physics.

arxiv-2512-01049.title: A Fast Algorithm for Finding Minimum Weight Cycles in Mining Cyclic Graph Topologies
arxiv-2512-01049.creator: Heman Shakeri, Torben Amtoft, Behnaz Moradi-Jamei, Nathan Albin, Pietro Poggi-Corradini
arxiv-2512-01049.description: Abstract Cyclic structures are fundamental topological features in graphs, playing critical roles in network robustness, information flow, community structure, and various dynamic processes. Algorithmic tools that can efficiently probe and analyze these cyclic topologies are increasingly vital for tasks in graph mining, network optimization, bioinformatics, and social network analysis.

arxiv-2605-08126.creator: Marwa Ennaceur

pmc-10567998.title: Ready for rapid rule-out of acute myocardial infarction
pmc-10567998.creator: Goaris W A Aarts, Cyril Camaro, Niels van Royen
pmc-10567998.description: Graphical Abstract Graphical AbstractPros and cons of a dual biomarker strategy for patients with a suspected acute myocardial infarction (AMI). Suspected AMI patients are transported to the emergency department (ED) to rule-in or rule-out an AMI. Chest pain is the most common reason for emergency medical contact and ED overcrowding is a growing problem worldwide.

pmc-10574028.title: Motion of Air Bubbles in a Cement Slurry
pmc-10574028.creator: N’dri Arthur Konan, Eilis Rosenbaum, Mehrdad Massoudi, Huisu Chen
pmc-10574028.description: The dynamics of air (gas) bubbles in a column of cement slurry is examined numerically. The air injected at the bottom of a laboratory-scale column through a porous distributor plate spatially distributes and migrates as a swarm of bubbles throughout the slurry toward the freeboard.

pmc-11309470.title: The origin, deployment, and evolution of a plant-parasitic nematode effectorome
pmc-11309470.creator: Beth Molloy, Dio S. Shin, Jonathan Long, Clement Pellegrin, Beatrice Senatori, Paulo Vieira, Peter J. Thorpe, Anika Damm, Mariam Ahmad, Kerry Vermeulen, Lida Derevnina, Siyuan Wei, Alexis Sperling, Estefany Reyes Estévez, Samuel Bruty, Victor Hugo Moura de Souza, Olaf Prosper Kranse, Tom Maier, Thom
pmc-11309470.description: Plant-parasitic nematodes constrain global food security. During parasitism, they secrete effectors into the host plant from two types of pharyngeal gland cells. These effectors elicit profound changes in host biology to suppress immunity and establish a unique feeding organ from which the nematode draws nutrition.

pmc-11352993.title: Glide Path in Endodontics: A Literature Review of Current Knowledge
pmc-11352993.creator: Vlad Mircea Lup, Giulia Malvicini, Carlo Gaeta, Simone Grandini, Gabriela Ciavoi, Jorge Nuno do Martins
pmc-11352993.description: The introduction of nickel–titanium rotary instruments revolutionized shaping procedures as they were able to produce a well-tapered preparation while reducing operator fatigue. The major drawback of rotary instruments was the high risk of fracture due to bending and torsional stress. Thus, the creation of a glide path has been advocated and recommended by most rotary instrument manufacturers.

pmc-11507337.title: The Complete Chloroplast Genome of Meconopsis simplicifolia and Its Genetic Comparison to Other Meconopsis Species
pmc-11507337.creator: Min Sun, Zhidan Zhu, Rui Li
pmc-11507337.description: Background: Chloroplasts, due to their high conservation and lack of recombination, serve as important genetic resources for the classification and evolutionary analysis of closely related species that are difficult to distinguish based on their morphological features. Meconopsis simplicifolia (M. simplicifolia), an endangered herb within the Meconopsis genus, has demonstrated therapeutic potential in treating various diseases.

pmc-12373605.title: A new twist on lactate signaling: alanyl-tRNA synthetases 1 and 2 as metabolic sensors and lactyltransferases
pmc-12373605.creator: Ting Xiao, Fubing Wang, Xinghua Long
pmc-12373605.description: by metabolic cues and offers potential therapeutic avenues for immune and inflammatory diseases. One of the important metabolic characteristics of tumor cells is their tendency to use aerobic glycolysis to metabolize glucose, which produces large amounts of lactate, a process known as the Warburg effect.

pmc-12542092.title: Registered nurses’ experiences and preparedness for Hajj mass gatherings: an exploratory study
pmc-12542092.creator: Thawab Alrabie, Michael Brown, Billiejoan Rice, Lynne Marsh
pmc-12542092.description: BackgroundMass gatherings such as the Hajj pose significant challenges to healthcare systems due to extreme crowd density, environmental stressors, and increased risk of medical emergencies. These events require robust preparedness and highly coordinated medical responses. However, existing literature indicates critical gaps in the readiness of registered nurses.

pmc-12590226.title: Metabolomics in neonatal sepsis: A critical appraisal of current evidence
pmc-12590226.creator: Aliya Baizhanova, Zhalaliddin Makhammajanov, Dinara Galiyeva, Olga Mironova, Abduzhappar Gaipov, Vitaliy Sazonov
pmc-12590226.description: Neonatal sepsis remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide; however, timely and accurate diagnosis continues to present a significant clinical challenge. Current diagnostic methods, including blood culture and inflammatory markers, are limited by delayed turnaround times and a lack of specificity, often leading to overtreatment or missed opportunities for intervention.

pmc-12619646.title: Epidemiology and Antifungal Susceptibility Trends of Candidemia: A 5-Year Retrospective Study at King Abdulaziz University Hospital
pmc-12619646.creator: Shaymaa A Abdalal, Dalya M Attallah, Jawahir A Mokhtar, Reham Mohammedsaeed Kaki, Hatoon A Niyazi, Hanouf A Niyazi, Moroj A Aldarmasi
pmc-12619646.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCandidemia, a bloodstream infection caused by Candida species, poses a significant clinical challenge, especially in immunocompromised individuals and intensive care unit (ICU) patients. Prompt diagnosis and treatment are crucial, as delayed antifungal therapy is associated with higher mortality rates. This study, conducted at King Abdulaziz University Hospital (KAUH) in Saudi Arabia, aimed to investigate the clinical and microbiological aspects of candidemia.MethodsThis study is a retrospective analysis, KAUH in Saudi Arabia, using data from January 2017 to March 2021.

pmc-12652931.title: Linguistic Markers in Spontaneous Speech: Insights into Subjective Cognitive Decline (Review)
pmc-12652931.creator: Sofia Segkouli, Mara Gkioka, Stylianos Kokkas, Konstantinos Votis, Sergi Valero, Andrea Miguel, Athos Antoniades, Emily Charalambous, George Manias, Madeleine E Hackney
pmc-12652931.description: Background and Objectives: Population rapid growth and demographic shift is leading to a rise in neurodegenerative disorders such as dementia and mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Evidence indicates that MCI is not the earliest phase of prodromal AD. Subjective Memory Decline (SMD) refers to a self-perceived decline in cognitive abilities compared to previous functioning levels in individuals with normal cognition.

pmc-13395752.title: Laryngeal Mask Airway Rescue After Failed Intubation for Tracheal Resection in Severe Subglottic Stenosis: A Case Report
pmc-13395752.creator: Keuntak Yuk, Hyunjeong Hwang, Seungho Kim

pmc-13422809.title: Does the exercise environment matter? Indoor versus outdoor aerobic exercise for adolescents with subthreshold depression: a randomised controlled trial protocol
pmc-13422809.creator: Guofeng Liu, Fei Gong, Jing Yu, Songsong Wang, Dan Chen, Qiang Zhang

pmc-13486551.title: Odor tracking in flying Drosophila requires visual reafference and compass neurons
pmc-13486551.creator: John Paul Currea, Ava E. Bignell, Isabelle Rieke-Wey, Daniela Limbania, Brian J. Duistermars, Sara M. Wasserman, Mark A. Frye
pmc-13486551.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SignificanceA crucial brain function that remains largely mysterious is building robust working memory by integrating stimuli across sensory modalities. For flying Drosophila, visual feedback is required to localize an odor source. A group of cells residing in the navigation center of the fly brain [Ellipsoid body-Protocerebral bridge-Gall (E-PG) neurons] have been shown to function like an internal compass, providing a reference frame for downstream circuits that can encode directional memory of heading changes akin to mammalian head-direction cells.

pmc-13510568.title: Multi-Mode Integrated Bioinspired Electronic Tongue for Point-of-Care Tear Diagnosis
pmc-13510568.creator: Xiao-Xin Liang, Haochen Wu, Yong Wang

pmc-13587919.title: Revascularization Gaps in Diabetic Foot Disease in Nigeria: Health-System Constraints and the Need for a National Limb-Salvage Strategy
pmc-13587919.creator: Oladimeji Adedeji Junaid
pmc-13587919.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Diabetic foot ulceration remains a major cause of non-traumatic lower-limb amputation, disability, prolonged hospitalisation and excess mortality. Nigerian studies document substantial burdens of ulceration, late presentation and amputation, but national data on vascular assessment, referral and revascularization remain limited.Methodology:PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar and African Journals Online, together with relevant guideline, epidemiology, health-financing and programme websites, were searched from inception to 15 July 2026.

pmc-13598234.title: Regulation of immune signal integration and memory by inflammation-induced chromosome conformation
pmc-13598234.creator: Bence Daniel, Andy Y. Chen, Katalin Sandor, Wenxi Zhang, Zhuang Miao, Kathryn E. Yost, Caleb A. Lareau, Howard Y. Chang, Ansuman T. Satpathy
pmc-13598234.description: SignificanceInnate immune cells integrate inflammatory cues and retain transcriptional memory, a phenomenon previously attributed mainly to one-dimensional epigenetic mechanisms. We show that inflammatory cytokine exposure remodels the three-dimensional (3D) genome of macrophages by establishing stable chromatin loops that persist after stimulus withdrawal.

pmc-13633409.title: Jejunal Perforation Associated With a Horseshoe‐Shaped Abdominal Contusion After a Horse Kick: A Case Report
pmc-13633409.creator: Jun Yoshida, Takehiko Hanaki, Yu Sakano, Yoshiyuki Fujiwara
pmc-13633409.description: A horseshoe‐shaped abdominal contusion after a horse kick may indicate the site of underlying bowel injury. When accompanied by persistent abdominal pain or peritoneal signs, hollow viscus injury should be considered. Contrast‐enhanced CT can identify free air and focal bowel abnormalities at the impact site, facilitating timely surgical management.

pmc-13647604.title: Single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of postnatal camel liver development identifies candidate adaptive features
pmc-13647604.creator: Huiquan Shan, Ao Zhang, Haotian Li, Tao Shi, Yongqing Li, Weiwei Wu, Xihong Wang
pmc-13647604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCamels possess distinctive physiological traits related to metabolism and environmental resilience, highlighting the need to characterize liver cellular composition in this species.ResultsWe used single-nucleus RNA sequencing to generate a developmental atlas of the Bactrian camel (Camelus bactrianus) liver using one individual from each of the newborn, weaning, and adult stages, analyzing 57,036 cells and identifying 19 cell types, including hepatocytes, liver sinusoidal endothelial cells (LSECs), and immune cells.
